actions.create_conversation.description: Creates a new conversation with a bot.
actions.create_conversation.props.docume: A list of document IDs to limit the bot's knowledge base for this conversation.
actions.create_conversation.props.name.d: The name for the new conversation.
actions.create_conversation_ai.descripti: Start a new conversation thread with a Cody bot.
actions.create_conversation_ai.props.bot: The ID of the bot to converse with. Resolve via List Bots.
actions.create_conversation_ai.props.doc: A list of document IDs to limit the bot's knowledge base for this conversation (focus mode, max 1000). Resolve via List Documents. Omit to use the bot's full knowledge base.
actions.create_conversation_ai.props.nam: The name for the new conversation.
actions.create_document_from_text.descri: Upload text content to create a new document within the Cody knowledge base.
The text or HTML content to be added to the document. Max 768 KB.
The name or title of the new document.
actions.create_document_from_webpage.des: Scrape a web page URL into a new Cody knowledge-base document.
actions.create_document_from_webpage.pro: The ID of the folder to create the document in. Resolve via List Folders.
The full URL of the web page to scrape, including protocol, e.g. 'https://example.com/page'.
actions.create_folder.props.name.descrip: The name of the new folder.
actions.create_text_document.description: Create a Cody knowledge-base document from raw text or HTML.
actions.create_text_document.props.conte: The text or HTML content to be added to the document. Max 768 KB.
actions.create_text_document.props.folde: The ID of the folder to create the document in. Resolve via List Folders.
The name or title of the new document.
actions.custom_api_call.description: Make a custom API call to a specific endpoint
actions.custom_api_call.props.failsafe.d: On a failed request, output the error instead of failing the step.
actions.custom_api_call.props.followRedi: Follow 3xx redirects instead of returning them as the response.
actions.custom_api_call.props.headers.de: Authorization headers are injected automatically from your connection.
actions.custom_api_call.props.response_i: Enable for files like PDFs, images, etc.
actions.custom_api_call.props.timeout.de: Seconds to wait for a response. Empty: up to the flow limit (10 min).
actions.delete_conversation.description: Permanently delete a Cody conversation by its ID.
actions.delete_conversation.props.conver: The ID of the conversation to permanently delete. Resolve via List Conversations.
actions.delete_document.description: Permanently delete a document from the Cody knowledge base.
actions.delete_document.props.document_i: The ID of the document to permanently delete. Resolve via List Documents.
actions.find_bot.description: Finds a bot based on its name.
actions.find_bot.props.name.description: The name of the bot to search for. The search is case-insensitive and partial.
actions.find_conversation.description: Finds a conversation based on its name and/or the bot it belongs to.
actions.find_conversation.props.name.des: The name of the conversation to search for (partial match).
actions.get_conversation.description: Retrieve a single Cody conversation by its ID.
actions.get_conversation.props.conversat: The ID of the conversation to retrieve. Resolve via List Conversations.
Optional comma-separated related data to embed in the response. One or more of: 'document_ids', 'messages'.
actions.get_document.description: Retrieve a single Cody knowledge-base document by its ID.
actions.get_document.props.document_id.d: The ID of the document to retrieve. Resolve via List Documents.
actions.get_folder.description: Retrieve a single Cody knowledge-base folder by its ID.
actions.get_folder.props.folder_id.descr: The ID of the folder to retrieve. Resolve via List Folders.
actions.get_message.description: Retrieve a single Cody message by its ID.
actions.get_message.props.includes.descr: Optional comma-separated related data to embed in the response.
actions.get_message.props.message_id.des: The ID of the message to retrieve. Resolve via List Messages.
actions.list_bots.description: List or search the bots in the Cody workspace.
actions.list_bots.props.keyword.descript: Optional name keyword to filter bots by (case-insensitive partial match). Omit to list all bots.
actions.list_conversations.description: List or search conversations in the Cody workspace.
Optional bot ID to list conversations for. Resolve via List Bots. Omit to list across all bots.
actions.list_conversations.props.keyword: Optional name keyword to filter conversations by (partial match). Omit to list all.
actions.list_documents.description: List or search documents in the Cody knowledge base.
actions.list_documents.props.conversatio: Optional conversation ID to list the focus-mode documents of. Resolve via List Conversations.
actions.list_documents.props.folder_id.d: Optional folder ID to list documents from. Resolve via List Folders. Omit to list across all folders.
actions.list_documents.props.keyword.des: Optional name keyword to filter documents by (partial match).
actions.list_documents.props.per_page.de: Optional number of documents to return per page.
actions.list_folders.description: List or search the knowledge-base folders in the Cody workspace.
actions.list_folders.props.keyword.descr: Optional name keyword to filter folders by (partial match). Omit to list all folders.
actions.list_folders.props.per_page.desc: Optional number of folders to return per page.
actions.list_messages.description: List the messages in a Cody conversation.
actions.list_messages.props.conversation: The ID of the conversation whose messages to list. Resolve via List Conversations.
actions.list_messages.props.per_page.des: Optional number of messages to return per page.
actions.rename_folder.props.folder_id.de: The ID of the folder to rename. Resolve via List Folders.
actions.rename_folder.props.name.descrip: The new name for the folder.
actions.send_message.description: Send your message and receive the AI-generated response.
actions.send_message.props.content.descr: The message to send to the conversation. (Max 2000 characters)
actions.send_message_ai.description: Send a message to a Cody conversation and get the bot reply.
actions.send_message_ai.props.content.de: The message to send to the conversation. Max 2000 characters.
actions.send_message_ai.props.conversati: The ID of the conversation to post into. Resolve via List Conversations or Create Conversation.
actions.update_conversation.description: Update a Cody conversation (full replace of name, bot, and focus documents).
actions.update_conversation.props.bot_id: The bot ID for the conversation. Required (full replace): re-send the current bot ID if you only want to rename. Resolve via List Bots.
actions.update_conversation.props.conver: The ID of the conversation to update. Resolve via List Conversations.
actions.update_conversation.props.docume: Optional list of document IDs to set as the focus-mode documents for this conversation (full replace). Re-send the current focus documents (from Get Conversation) to keep them; omitting may clear focus mode. Resolve via List Documents.
actions.update_conversation.props.name.d: The conversation name. Required (full replace): re-send the current name if you only want to change the bot.
actions.upload_file.description: Add a file directly into a specific folder in the knowledge base.
actions.upload_file.props.file.descripti: The file to upload (e.g., txt, md, rtf, pdf, ppt, docx).
actions.upload_file_to_kb.description: Upload a binary file into a Cody knowledge-base folder.
actions.upload_file_to_kb.props.file.des: The file to upload (e.g., txt, md, rtf, pdf, ppt, docx).
actions.upload_file_to_kb.props.folder_i: The ID of the folder to upload the file into. Resolve via List Folders.
auth.description: Visit your Cody AI API Keys page to retrieve the API key.
